Additionally, load balancers can be used for automated scaling in order to cope with dynamic changes in load. By allowing for an optimization of data diffusion swiftness, load balancing proves to be a vital component to build high-performing and reliable distributed applications.

articleTitle: Design and Implement Multiple Disease Prediction System
abstract: As we know now-a-days, people suffer with lot of diseases, due to various reasons like, living habits or environmental conditions, some diseases are not known from the root but after some time these diseases become deadly. So, these diseases should be predicted from its early stage. But sometimes it becomes difficult for doctors to make accurate predictions and it becomes the most challenging task. So, to come out of this problem machine learning and data science play the most important role. This paper put forward all in one disease prediction system based on reports and various parameters of the patients. We will use random forest and CNN (Convolution neural network) algorithm for the accurate prediction of these diseases. For these diseases prediction we will require datasets to train and test our model. Our model will also suggest the precautions for the person and diet he/she should follow.

articleTitle: Industrial Automation using VR and AI
abstract: Automation anywhere, is the process of using technology to perform certain tasks or processes that could otherwise be done or performed by humans. Automation is leading to transformation of various processes and industries, and the combination of AI and VR in automation has opened new possibilities and paths for businesses and organizations to optimize their operations. Machine learning (ML) algorithms can process and work on vast amounts of data and generate valuable insights that can help us perform certain tasks and inform decision-making algorithms about it. VR which is another evolving technology can enhance the experience of the user and facilitate remote collaboration. This paper depicts about Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Virtual Reality (VR) and Automation in industries, and it also tries to demonstrate the audience about how these mechanisms are related to each other and how they can be more effective when they work together and can give competitive and industrial advantage. The aim of this review paper is to explore the latest research and developments in automation, virtual reality, and artificial intelligence, with a particular focus on their applications in various industries and their implications for society as a whole.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction Method of Watt-Hour Meter Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
abstract: Their components are complex and the fault types are diverse. Most maintenance personnel do not have the ability to repair all types of faults. Therefore, when smart meters fail, they can accurately predict the guide the operation and maintenance personnel to dispatch, It will effectively reduce the human and resource costs and maintenance. The demand for electricity. The current situation requires and electricity to meet the growing. In this case, it is very important to predict the possible faults in the power system, so that these faults can be avoided at any cost. This can be achieved by using various technologies, such as load forecasting, voltage stress testing, etc. However, an uncommon technology is the watt-hour meter fault prediction method (WattFPA). The fault prediction technology of intelligent watt-hour meter is studied. Firstly, a deep neural network structure that can extract the depth attribute of fault data is designed, and the model optimization and parameter debugging methods are studied, and the optimal model is constructed; Secondly, in multi-class in intelligent meter fault prediction, a cost-sensitive multi-class XGBoost model is designed, and the relevant parameter debugging method is analyzed, and the model effect is verified on the test data.

articleTitle: Graphical Password Authentication Using Decentralized Single-Sign-On
abstract: Authentication is a crucial process that verifies the identity of an individual or system seeking access to resources or services. Password-based authentication systems, which are the most common and widely used, can be complex, difficult to remember, and vulnerable to various attacks. Graphical passwords offer a more user-friendly alternative to text-based passwords and have been validated by software companies and psychology research. However, existing password authentication systems, including OAuth2.0, Google Auth, and Facebook Auth, have limitations, such as single-point failure, centralized architecture, privacy concerns, and resource-intensive computation systems. This paper proposes a decentralized platform, Visual-D-Auth, that leverages blockchain and IPFS technologies to provide secure and reliable access to users through a Decentralized Single Sign-On (DSSO) technique. The Visual-D-Auth system eliminates the need for remembering multiple usernames and passwords in a decentralized environment while providing improved security, user privacy, and convenience. The paper introduces a unique graphical password generation algorithm that generates highly secure passwords using a combination of images and a user-selected username. Finally, the Visual-D-Auth solutions address the most common weaknesses of graphical password systems, such as shoulder-surfing and smudge attacks, offering a more secure and user-friendly solution. Overall, this research presents a novel approach to authentication that could potentially revolutionize the way we authenticate access to resources and services.

articleTitle: Tableau-Based Data Visualization and Regression Analysis of Landcover and Climatic Trends
abstract: Visualization is a key technology for analyzing and presenting vegetation cover and climatic changes. Interactive visualization has emerged as a popular and effective approach for communicating complex data and insights related to climate change. This project focuses on the interactive visualization of land cover and climate changes using conventional maps and graphs, with a particular focus on the districts of Rajasthan. By utilizing the data provided by the Bhuvan geǒ platform, this study aims to identify trends in climate and land cover over the past 30 years. The datasets collected for this study include information on climatic aspects such as temperature, Earth surface temperature, humidity, and precipitation for the cities of Jodhpur, Bikaner, and Jaisalmer, as well as land cover data for the major districts in Rajasthan. The land cover includes data on croplands, forests, builtup lands, and water bodies which were collected for the years 2011-12 and 2015-16. The use of Tableau software provides an interactive platform for analyzing and presenting data, making it easier for stakeholders and policymakers to understand the data and make informed decisions. Linear regression is used to establish relationship and predict the climatic changes corresponding to change in years. This study aims to provide an accurate representation of the data, including detailed information about the source, in a way that makes it easy to understand complicated data relationships and datǎ driven insights. Through interactive data visualization, this study aims to identify how land cover and climate trends are changing over time and to identify potential causes for these changes. The final result is the visualized data report which helps to identify the trends in climate and land cover.

articleTitle: Hardware Based Attendance System Using Blockchain
abstract: Current attendance systems suffer from several issues, such as being paper-based which makes it difficult to maintain and record data accurately. Furthermore, it is possible for students or employees to record the attendance of others who are not present. Digital attendance systems based on biometric features like fingerprints or faces exist, but they are centralized and susceptible to manipulation by a centralized entity. To address this issue, there is a need for a decentralized system that utilizes cryptography to ensure that only the person who is present can mark their attendance. In our proposed system, both the operator and member have their own private keys, and only together can they mark the attendance. This system ensures that attendance can only be marked by the student who is present using their own private key, which cannot be shared, and if attempted, the private key will be locked. The proposed system adds a proof of attendance for the member, allowing them to generate unique signatures that can identify attendees on any decentralized record.

articleTitle: Empowering Digital Banking Services and Enhancing Financial Inclusion using Smart and Robust Fintech Software Solutions
abstract: Financial inclusion refers to the process of providing access to formal financial services to all members of society. It is a critical issue that affects individuals and communities around the world. The paper provides an overview of financial inclusion, its importance, and the limitations faced by traditional financial institutions in providing financial services and possible technology powered solution based on digital finance to the unbanked population We are exploring how digital finance and fintech have influenced financial inclusion in developing countries and discuss how fintech has achieved growth and impacted on the baking penetration around the world. The study analysis the role of agency banking, SMS banking, and mobile money systems in promoting financial inclusion by understanding their working process and befits. The paper aims to provide a software solution that can improve financial inclusion in developing nations. Using modern tech stack these methods can be implemented into a single software which centralizes the transaction process in overall system and reduces cost per transaction. The proposed system will eliminate the need for physical assets and reduce the costs associated with traditional methods of financial inclusion. As smart phone usage and internet access had sharp uptrend in recent years these tech enabled fintech startups have resulted into increased access, affordability, and usability of financial services. The paper also includes a market analysis, user adoption, and scalability study, which provides insight into the potential of the proposed system and fintech startups across developing nations.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Modified BPSO for Feature Selection with RNN Variants on Top Tech Companies
abstract: The most often utilized data in recent years is time series data, used for things like stock market price prediction and others. Recent research has focused chiefly on stock market prediction using neural networks, and new techniques are being developed to improve these models' accuracy. One such method uses optimization algorithms like PSO, GWO, or GA. Other variants, such as Binary-PSO and Binary-GWO, are developed by further enhancing the original algorithms. The paper suggested a variant of BPSO called MBPSO / TBPSO that assigned binary values to the features during optimization using the “tanh” activation function. The TBPSO is then applied individually for two, five, and ten years to the datasets of five leading Tech firms. The dataset, which comprises a variety of historical and technical indicators, is applied to different variants of RNN and finds the best results with the GRU model to forecast the closing stock price. What transpired proves that, when used for prediction on the GRU model and when choosing more features than BPSO, TBPSO provides us with features that will provide more accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Congestion Control Techniques to Improve QoS and Frequent Communication in FANET
abstract: Fanets, or Flying Ad Hoc Networks, is a field of study that is very interested in how unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) communicate with each other. Due to the ever-changing topology of a network, it might be difficult for mobile nodes to effectively communicate with one another. There is no physical infrastructure supporting this network, but the nodes, or UAVs, are equipped to deal with much more data than can be collected by sensors. Also, since UAVs fly so low to the ground, using short-range wireless links yields far better performance than using high-altitude wireless connectivity. Adaptive communications and a UAV mobility model developed in tandem can also increase performance. When a UAV has a stable connection to the ground station, for instance, it needs to move at a slower rate to maintain wireless contact. One of the most crucial indicators of a network’s efficiency is its routing. In this article, we propose analysis on how to improve QoS by controlling energy usage, congestion, and geolocation data by UAVs. QoS service improvement is influenced by a wide variety of factors, however, this analysis is focusing on energy, congestion, and physical location, size of UAVs and importance of UAVs in agriculture. To preserve network lifetime and keep the ratio of properly delivered packets and conventional routing mechanisms high, adaptively selected routes using minimal-cost routing and modified or updated routing techniques based on network conditions are used. A study of routing protocols is also discussed here in order to better understand the work being done in this area and to enhance routing protocol performance.

articleTitle: The Smart Analysis of Multi-Attention Based Sentimental Optimization Model for Complex Data Fusion in High Density Cloud Servers
abstract: Multi-attention based sentimental optimization model for complex data fusion is a new hybrid model for sentiment analysis of complicated datasets. It combines multiple complementary mechanisms, including a recurrent neural network (RNN) with an attention memory network and an administrative technique to organize multi-modal training data. The model can not only provide high accuracy in sentiment categorization, but also be able to learn from partially labeled training data. Firstly, the RNN helps to capture detailed and complex information from the mixtures of heterogeneous features. Also, the attention memory network helps to summarize high-level features of the data and establish correspondent relationships with other dimensions of the input data. Finally, the administrative technique helps to make use of multiple sources of knowledge to optimize the model performances. This hybrid model has the ability to capture cross-modal relations and common features of multiple datasets and allows for a more effective fusion process. In summary, the multi-attention based sentimental optimization model for complex data fusion is an effective and efficient tool for sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of College Students' Employment Based on Decision Tree Classification Algorithm
abstract: Decision tree is a decision technology, which helps make decisions by using the tree representation of options and their results. Decision trees are used to analyze and predict the results of different situations. Decision trees are widely used in marketing, finance, management and many other fields. The purpose of this study is to analyze and predict the employment status of college students according to their decision-making process. This research will be carried out on two groups of students: those who choose to study engineering as their major and those who choose business management as their major. Use this model to find some hidden and useful factors and internal links that affect students' employment. And the model can be used to guide schools to carry out teaching reform, guide graduates to choose suitable employment units according to their own learning conditions, avoid students taking fewer detours in the employment process, and greatly improve the employment rate of students. At the same time, it also promotes students' purposeful and selective learning. In order to meet the needs of social development, it constantly improves its own quality and knowledge structure, improves its employment competitiveness, and also plays a guiding and auxiliary role in school management decision-making.

articleTitle: Enhancing Organizational Collaboration and Communication through a Social Management Platform
abstract: In today’s world of social media and instant communication, privacy boundaries are becoming increasingly blurred, and it’s not uncommon for public interactions to encroach on our private spaces. To address this issue, we propose a professional platform that allows for communication and networking without compromising privacy. Our goal is to create an application that enables users to maintain contact with peers, seniors, and juniors in a professional setting without sharing personal contact details with unknown individuals. Through our project, we aim to leverage technologies to provide a safe and secure space for professional interactions. By doing so, we hope to facilitate productive communication and networking among individuals without intruding on their personal lives.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Simulation of Offensive and Defensive Tactics in Robot World Cup
abstract: The Robot Cup is an international initiative aimed at promoting research in robotics and artificial intelligence. One of the key research areas of the Robot Cup is the development of offensive and defensive tactics for soccer robots. Computer simulation played a crucial role in this study, enabling researchers to test different strategies and evaluate their effectiveness. Computer simulation enables researchers to create virtual environments where they can test different scenarios without the need for physical robots. This method has several advantages, including cost-effectiveness, flexibility, and scalability. Researchers can simulate different game situations, such as attacking or defending opponents, and evaluate the performance of their strategies. One of the challenges in developing effective tactics for soccer robots is the complexity of the game. Football involves multiple players interacting with each other in a dynamic environment. Computer simulation enables researchers to model these interactions and test different strategies under various conditions. Overall, computer simulation research on the offensive and defensive tactics of the Robot Cup has made significant contributions to our understanding of how robots effectively play football. With the advancement of technology, we can look forward to further progress in this field, where more complex simulations will bring more advanced robot players. The purpose of this study is to improve the performance of robots at the World Cup. The main problem we need to solve first is how to provide a good simulation environment for robots. It helps us understand the relationships between various factors; It enables us to test new ideas, making our work more efficient.

articleTitle: The Enhanced Canonical Correlation Analysis for Cardiac Arrest Prediction Using Fusional MRI Data
abstract: This study evaluates the performance of Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) for predicting the risk of cardiac arrest in individuals with congenital heart disease through the application of fusional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data. The fMRI data used were collected from a cohort of 58 individuals, of which 26 were selected as the target group, who experienced cardiac arrest at least once in their lifetime. The remaining 32 patients were selected as the control group and did not suffer any cardiac arrest episode. Correlation coefficients were extracted from the fMRI data using CCA to identify correlations between the target and the control groups. Results of this analysis indicated that the correlations between the target and the control groups were significant, providing potential predictive validity to the CCA model with respect to cardiac arrest. Furthermore, the CCA model was found to be reliable in terms of distinguishing between high- and low-risk patients, suggesting its potential use as a clinical tool for personalized cardiac care. In conclusion, this study suggests that CCA has the potential to serve as a reliable tool for personalized cardiac care and for predicting risk of cardiac arrest in individuals with congenital heart disease.

articleTitle: A Specific Power Management Protocol for Minimizing and Managing the Power Drain of the WSN
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) provide wide-area monitoring and control of remote conditions. WSNs are composed of numerous miniature devices that are powered by their own batteries with limited energy, thus having to manage the power drain carefully. The main challenge of power management in WSNs is to maximize the network lifespan by scheduling the monitoring activities and optimizing the data transfer rate. Therefore, various power control methods were proposed to reduce energy consumption and extend the network lifetime. This article provides an overview of the power management techniques used to reduce energy consumption in WSNs. Specifically, this article explains various scheduling, routing and sleeping techniques that are used to manage the power drain in WSNs.

articleTitle: The Smart Forecast Investigation Model for Stress Suffered Patients Using Opinion Based Sentimental optimization System
abstract: The use of opinion-based sentiment optimization systems to help patients manage and cope with stress has become increasingly popular. These systems support individual patient management through personalized advice and personalized reminders to follow through with self-care. Such systems are able to process large amounts of data in order to accurately detect and quantify sentiment, creating an opportunity for more effective patient-physician interactions. Further, the incorporation of real-time patient feedback and automated sentiment processing allows for more accurate patient monitoring. This system can ultimately help reduce stress levels and improve overall health outcomes.

articleTitle: New Modified Adaptive Learning Neural Network for Coverage and Connectivity Issues in WSN Using Energy Efficient Routing Algorithm
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are increasingly being employed in a variety of applications ranging from military to infrastructure monitoring. However, with the ever-increasing demand of higher coverage, better connectivity, and accuracy, optimization of such networks is becoming a complex task. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel Modified Adaptive Learning Neural Network (M-ALNN).This new method is designed to address both coverage and connectivity issues within a given WSN. The MALNN adaptively optimizes WSNs by taking advantage of state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms. The proposed algorithm uses a combination of two different algorithms, viz., the Supervised Neuron Algorithm (SNA) and the K-Means Clustering Algorithm, to achieve optimal coverage and reconfiguration of network topology. Both SNA and K-Means Algorithm are trained through a reinforcement learning algorithm to adaptively adjust their parameters as per the current application requirements. After optimization, the proposed M-ALNN algorithm improves the coverage and connectivity of WSNs by adjusting the network parameters. Simulation experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Results show that our proposed network outperforms the conventional WSN in terms of coverage and connectivity when tested under various scenarios.

articleTitle: Routing Techniques in Body Sensor Network System for Healthcare: Applications, Challenges, and Research Trends
abstract: Pre-analysis of health using sensor technologies will become quite popular during this decade and will be used by the common citizen as well. Transmission of body parameters is crucial in the Body Sensor Network (BSN) system because erroneous transmission can result in a number of problems, including energy waste, transmission delays, data loss, decreased stability, and poor data transfer efficiency. In the last ten years, many research were done to address these problems, particularly in light of the development of biosensors. This paper will discuss many research projects based on various BSN routing techniques. The author described innovative work completed for effective information transmission in a BSN and demonstrated a comparison study based on six crucial parameters: stability, network lifetime, energy efficient, reliable, network delay, and throughput. The author also discusses various challenges and research trends that have been reported by various authors throughout their research.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Network Lifetime by Adding Pollination Algorithm with Optimization Technique for WSN
abstract: The traditional routing protocols used in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) have focused on finding paths of minimum costs in attempts to maximize network lifetime. Several of these protocols are unsuitable for networks with diverse and distributed network topologies. This paper presents the Pollination Algorithm (PA), a novel algorithm that utilizes the principles of pollination in its routing. Specifically, the PA uses a privacy-preserving probabilistic technique, which takes advantage of the humans’ sense of smell in order to effectively and reliably disseminate data across the network. Simulation results show that PA achieves better performance in terms of the network lifetime and energy consumption when compared to traditional algorithms. The paper also discusses several issues related to PA, such as security and scalability. Furthermore, this paper provides a detailed discussion on the application of PA in communication networks.

articleTitle: Design of Education Management System Based on Apriori Algorithm
abstract: The design of an education management system based on Apriori algorithm is a promising method for improving the quality of education. Apriori algorithm is a data mining technique that can be used to identify patterns in large data sets. Applying this algorithm to educational data can identify trends and patterns, helping educators make informed decisions about curriculum development, student evaluation, and other aspects of educational management. A key advantage of using Apriori algorithm in education management is its ability to identify the correlation between different variables. For example, by analyzing student performance data and demographic information such as age, gender, and socioeconomic status, educators can gain insight into the factors that can lead to performance gaps. Another advantage of using Apriori algorithm in education management is its scalability. As the size and complexity of educational datasets continue to grow, traditional analytical methods may become less effective. However, the Apriori algorithm is designed to easily handle large datasets. Overall, the design of an education management system based on Apriori algorithm has great potential in improving educational outcomes and ensuring that all students receive high-quality learning opportunities. This article aims to improve the traditional classic Apriori algorithm by using a transaction identifier list to calculate the support and confidence of the newly generated candidate set to generate a frequent itemset for this layer. This fundamentally changes the shortcomings of traditional algorithms that require multiple database scans, greatly improving the algorithm’s running speed and reducing runtime overhead.

articleTitle: A Security Evaluation Method for Complex Computer Networks Based on GABP Algorithm
abstract: This paper proposes a security evaluation method for complex computer networks based on the GABP (Genetic Algorithm and Back Propagation) algorithm. This method first constructs a network topology model based on information such as network topology, network protocol and security policy, and converts it into a fitness function. Then use GABP algorithm to optimize the fitness function and get the optimal solution. Then, the optimal solution is used to evaluate network security, including security assessment and risk assessment. The experimental results show that this method can effectively evaluate the security of the network, improve the security of the network, and reduce the evaluation time and cost.

articleTitle: An Optimal Risk Prediction for Ovarian Cancer Patients Using Symptoms Based Canonical Correlation Analysis
abstract: Ovarian cancer is a major cause of morbidity and mortality among women, especially in elderly women. Early detection is of paramount importance for increasing the patient’s prognosis and survival rate. Symptoms-based canonical correlation analysis (SBCA) has emerged as a promising technique for risk prediction for ovarian cancer patients. SBCA is a multivariate statistical approach that combines features of principal component analysis and multiple linear regression. It is capable of uncovering relationships between a set of predictor variables and a set of outcome variables. The technique has been found to accurately predict the risks associated with ovarian cancer progression in a variety of populations. This study explores the effectiveness of SBCA as a tool for risk prediction in ovarian cancer patients. Results from this study suggest that SBCA accurately captures the risk factors associated with ovarian cancer progression and can be used to guide early detection and treatment options. This work has the potential to improve patient outcomes and reduce the burdensome economic and psychological costs associated with late detection of the disease.

articleTitle: Intelligent Tourism Route Optimization Based on Teaching and Learning Optimization Algorithms
abstract: With the rapid development of the tourism industry, traditional fixed and single tourism routes can no longer meet the needs of consumers. Designing reasonable, personalized and diversified tourism routes has become an urgent problem for the tourism industry to solve. The design of tourism routes is mainly divided into tourism node selection and node combinatorial optimization. Intelligent tourism route optimization is an important aspect of modern tourism planning. With the emergence of technology, optimizing travel routes based on various factors such as time, distance, and cost has become possible. One such method is to teach and learn optimization algorithms. Teaching and learning optimization algorithms are based on the principles of machine learning. They include training algorithms, learning from past experiences, and making predictions for future results. In the context of optimizing tourism routes, these algorithms can be used to analyze historical data related to travel patterns and preferences. By using teaching optimization algorithms, personalized travel routes can be created, taking into account individual preferences for activities, attractions, and accommodation. This method can also help travelers save time and money by determining the most effective route between destinations. Overall, intelligent travel route optimization based on teaching optimization algorithms may completely change our travel plans. It provides a more personalized approach that considers personal preferences while optimizing efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Applications of Accelerating Genetic Algorithms in System Engineering
abstract: Groundwater system engineering is a complex field that involves the management and optimization of water resources. The use of genetic algorithms has been proposed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of groundwater system engineering. Genetic algorithm is a computational tool simulating natural selection and evolution, which is used to find the best solution to complex problems. An accelerated genetic algorithm has been developed to accelerate the optimization process by reducing the required number of iterations. These algorithms use advanced technologies such as parallel processing, adaptive mutation rate, and elite selection strategies to quickly converge to the optimal solution. The application of accelerated genetic algorithm in groundwater system engineering has shown good results. They have been used to optimize oil well layout, pump scheduling, and pollutant remediation strategies. These optimization measures have significantly improved water resource management, including increased efficiency, reduced costs, and improved environmental effects. Overall, accelerated genetic algorithms are a powerful tool for improving groundwater system engineering. With the continuous development and improvement of these technologies, they will undoubtedly play an increasingly important role in managing our precious water resources. Based on FORTRAN90 computer language, this paper studies the application of accelerated genetic algorithm in engineering calculation of groundwater system..

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Reliable Weather Forecasting
abstract: Weather forecasting has always been a domain where more and more reliability is looked up to when it comes to prediction and the models pursued. While in the past years, traditional methods included conventional probability-dominated dependency models, the reliability of these traditional methods was always in a contentious line which emphasized the necessity to improve and use modern technology. While in the past few years, we became familiar with the ways that can put the huge amount of data to an optimum utility, it only widened the horizons which makes room for us to explore various important domains where reliability is indeed a necessity, that could very much use the help of advanced technology to be more decisive. The materializing deep learning techniques tied up to the humongous availability of observed data concerning the field of weather prediction have enticed enough researchers to traverse the concealed hierarchical pattern in the voluminous weather datasets. The study was done to inquire into various deep learning techniques including discussing some of the advanced and recently under-the-light methods.

articleTitle: Drug Quality Classification Using Sentiment Analysis of Drug Reviews
abstract: Since the pandemic emerged, there has been a shortage in remote access to medical resources, a lack of medical experts and healthcare professionals, an absence of adequate instruments and medicines etc. As a result, many people have passed away. As there is absence of resources, people started off following medical recommendations without sufficient consultation, giving rise to their wellbeing to decline should have been. In recent years, machine learning has found several useful uses. The main objective for the study was to give a drug review prediction which would help to decrease the number of health care specialists and authority needed. In this investigation, we are developing a drug review system that analyses sick persons feedback to forecast patient’s comments using various vectorization algorithms, such as the Count Vectorizer, TF-IDF, Bag of Words, and handy analysis of characteristics that can aid in identifying the most effective course of treatment for a condition using several classification methods. The predicted results were assessed using the precision, accuracy, AUC, and F1 scores. The results demonstrate that the Random Forest Classifier surpasses every other model with an accuracy rate of 94%.

articleTitle: A Comparative Evaluation and Analysis of Machine Learning Approaches for Predicting Breast Cancer
abstract: The use of machine learning in numerous domains is the main topic of this essay. It seeks to give a thorough review of the factors supporting its relevance and importance. This manual’s goal is to describe and emphasize the methods that are currently being used or considered both worldwide and in office settings. To forecast illness prognosis, many methods, tools, training, and education have been used, with varying degrees of success. Using these techniques is essential and acceptable in the field of computational biology. They have specifically been used to forecast breast cancer, whether through the evaluation of data on cancer based on profiles or sequences. Prediction of the enzyme class for unidentified breast cancer patients has been one of the important research fields throughout this time. Within the research community, this specific element has attracted a lot of interest and discussion. We have used machine learning methods and classifiers to address this problem. In the area of studying and forecasting enzyme classes, these techniques have shown to be successful. The primary objective of my research is to develop a model for automated analysis using two different algorithms. The intention behind this approach is to create two distinct models that can be tested for their validity and effectiveness. By doing so, we aim to determine which model is most suitable for protein analysis based on its precision and accuracy. This comparative evaluation will help us identify the algorithm that performs best in terms of accurately analyzing protein data.

articleTitle: Classification of Medicinal Leaves using SVM
abstract: Identification of medicinal plants is essential for the development of effective medicines and the preservation of biodiversity. The goal of the artificial intelligence discipline of computer vision is to make it possible for computers to comprehend and analyze visual information from their environment, mimicking the abilities of human vision to enable applications such as image and video recognition, object detection, and autonomous navigation. Statistical algorithms and computational models are used in the artificial intelligence branch of machine learning to enable computers to learn from data and make predictions or judgements without being explicitly programmed. This research employs Computer vision and Machine Learning for the classification of Medicinal leaves. This paper focuses on the classification of three medicinal plant species, namely Neem, Tulasi, and Peepal using leaf images as input and the SVM algorithm for classification. The proposed system processes input images by applying various image processing techniques such as histogram equalization, thresholding, and morphological operations to segment the leaf from the background. Several shape, and texture features were extracted from each leaf image such as its length, width, perimeter, area, aspect ratio, homogeneity and correlation. The system also extracts texture features using gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) analysis. The extracted features are then fed into a machine learning algorithm, specifically a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier, to classify the medicinal plant species. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score are some of the measures that are used to assess the model’s performance once the SVM algorithm has been optimised. This work lays the foundation for future research in this field and shows the potential of machine learning in the high accuracy classification of medicinal plants.

articleTitle: An Ultimate Benchmark for the Optimal Performance of Quantum Communication Network Using Multi Path Routing Protocol
abstract: In recent years, quantum communication networks have emerged as a promising alternative to classical communication networks for the transmission of quantum information. One of the challenges for achieving optimal performance in quantum communication networks is the efficient routing of quantum signals across multiple paths. To address this, a variety of routing protocols have been proposed, including multi-path routing protocols. Multi-path routing involves sending a quantum signal through multiple distinct paths simultaneously to reduce delays in the transmission of quantum information. By distributing the quantum information over multiple paths, this approach can provide significant performance improvements, including reduced latency and higher throughput. In addition, multi-path routing can enable new possibilities for the security of quantum communication networks, such as more secure entanglement swapping protocols and improved protection against eavesdropping. In this paper, we investigate the performance of multi-path routing protocols in multi-node quantum communication networks. We consider two approaches to multi-path routing, a basic routing approach based on shortest path optimization, and a more advanced approach based on graph partitions. We evaluate the performance of these protocols in a range of multi-node networks, with focus on the trade-off between latency and throughput. The results show that multi-path routing yields significant performance improvements in such networks and provides an efficient way for routing quantum signals across multiple paths.

articleTitle: Enhanced Filtering Techniques for an Advanced Fingerprint Recognition System
abstract: Human fingerprint artifacts, the surrounding environment, and the fingerprint-collecting equipment all contribute to less-than-ideal fingerprint images. Most digital photographs have extraneous details because of these image-altering effects. Therefore, a number of substantial changes are required to improve the efficacy of FRS. In the practice of enhancing an image by applying methods like filtering to boost its quality. Image filtering is a method that can enhance an image by eliminating unwanted details and minimizing noise. The process of picture filtering also includes other steps, such as smoothing and sharpening the original image. In this study, we developed an approach in which several filters, such as the Unsharp, Gaussian, and Averaging filters, are applied to the original picture. Experimental findings demonstrate that the ‘Unsharp filter’ improves image quality when using this kind of compression between filters.

articleTitle: A Robust Approach for Malware Attacks Detection in the Internet of Things Communications
abstract: The detection of malicious software is an essential activity for ensuring the ongoing security of the Internet of Things (IoT). Malware, often known as malicious software, is computer code designed to steal private information, corrupt data or files, or otherwise interfere with the functioning of a computer system. A number of different methods, including signature-based detection, heuristic analysis, and behaviour-based detection, are utilised in the process of identifying malicious software. The process of searching for specific patterns or signatures that are characteristic of known malware is what is referred to as signature-based detection. The success of this method is dependent on the upkeep of a database containing known malware signatures. Heuristic analysis, on the other hand, uses rules and algorithms to detect suspicious behaviour that may indicate the presence of malware. This approach does not rely on specific signatures but instead analyzes the code or behaviour of a file or program. If the behaviour exhibits characteristics commonly associated with malware, it is flagged as potentially malicious. Behaviour-based detection focuses on analyzing the behaviour of software programs to identify anomalous or malicious activity. Utilizing machine learning algorithms for malware detection helps to identify potential threats and prevent them from compromising valuable data and information. In this paper, we propose a robust approach for the detection and analysis of malware attacks in the communications of the IoT. In the proposed protocol various machine learning-based models, i.e., k-nearest neighbours (KNN), random forest and neural networks are used. The proposed protocol is also compared with the other similar existing protocols and it has achieved better accuracy as compared to the other existing protocols.

articleTitle: Method and System for Screening the Best Carrier Material in Lithium-Sulfur Battery Based on Machine Learning
abstract: Lithium-sulfur battery is the most common type of rechargeable battery in portable electronic devices. These batteries have high energy density and can discharge at a very high rate, which makes them very suitable for portable electronic devices. However, these batteries have several safety problems, which may cause catastrophic failure during discharge or overcharging. The most common problem of lithium-sulfur batteries is sulfation, which occurs when the anode (lithium side) is saturated with sulfuric acid and prevents further charge transfer from the cathode (sulfur side). This paper provides a method and system for selecting the best carrier material in lithium-sulfur battery based on machine learning, including: optimizing the structure of AB2 two-dimensional layered carrier material; Set up a variety of polysulfides, calculate the adsorption energy using density functional theory, and build a data set corresponding to the adsorption structure and adsorption energy; The structure in the data set is calculated by atomic local chemical environment to obtain the structure characteristics of the data set; The depth neural network is trained based on the structural characteristics of the data set, and the adsorption energy of any configuration and any site is predicted according to the trained depth neural network; The migration learning algorithm is used to adjust the parameters of the depth neural network for the preset AB2 type two-dimensional layered carrier material to adsorb polysulfide; The depth neural network for the preset AB2 type two-dimensional layered carrier material to adsorb polysulfides is trained, and the adsorption energy of any configuration and site is predicted according to the trained depth neural network, and the adsorption capacity is measured according to the average value.

articleTitle: A Review of Cloud Microservices Architecture for Modern Applications
abstract: As a potent architectural paradigm for creating and deploying contemporary applications in the cloud computing environment, cloud microservices have been developed. This review paper offers a thorough examination of the ideas, advantages, problems, and developments related to cloud microservices. We start by outlining the core ideas and traits of the microservices architecture and highlighting its benefits over more conventional monolithic ones. The advantages of using cloud microservices, such as scalability, robustness, and flexibility, are then discussed, along with the difficulties in implementing and managing them. The article compares the features and constraints of several cloud platforms and tools for deploying and orchestrating microservices, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Kubernetes. Real-world case studies highlight effective cloud microservices implementations and offer helpful insights and best practices. We also examine current trends in the field and recent research papers to determine where future research should be focused. Additionally, cloud microservice-specific security and governance issues are covered, with an emphasis on methods for encrypting communication, controlling access, and guaranteeing data privacy. This review paper seeks to increase the comprehension of this revolutionary architectural paradigm by providing a thorough examination of cloud microservices for modern applications.

articleTitle: Vision Based Object Dimension Detection
abstract: This paper presents a method for real-time object dimension detection of commonly used objects: pens, wallets, and keys. This system is ported on Jetson Nano. The results are translated as an audio output which helps especially the visually impaired individuals to identify the objects. This methodology involves data collection of the objects, preprocessing of the dataset. YOLO (You Only Look Once) model is trained and tested using the collected dataset. The deployment of low power embedded system is a novel approach of object detection and dimension detection in real-time with the use of Convolutional neural network algorithm. The system is efficient in detecting dimension with an accuracy of 84.35% for pen, 82.07% for key and 87.84% with dimensional variance of ±0.29 cm in length and ± 0.18 cm in width.

articleTitle: The Visual and Audio Performance Analysis for Homogeneous Modality Transfer Learning Using Opinion Mining
abstract: Homogeneous modality transfer learning is the process of training models to recognize the same objects or events based on different modalities. This type of learning has potential applications in a variety of areas such as automated speech recognition, object recognition and gesture recognition. This paper investigates the use of visual and audio performance analysis for homogeneous modality transfer learning. Specifically, we propose a visual and audio feature-based transfer learning approach that can improve the performance of transfer learning tasks on different datasets. To evaluate this approach, we conduct experiments on two public datasets: Google Speech Commands and Image Net. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in improving the performance of transfer learning tasks. In comparison with state-of-the-art approaches, the proposed approach outperforms them by up to 15% in terms of accuracy. Additionally, this approach is also resistant to the effects of data augmentation and ignores instances with noise. This makes the proposed approach suitable for heterogeneous applications.

articleTitle: Cyber Attack Risk Estimation Technique in Intelligent Cyber Physical System for Pharmaceutical Care Services
abstract: A Cyber Physical System (CPS) is a hybrid of physical and cyber systems that are inextricably linked. It is widely employed in vital national infrastructure industries such as healthcare, electric power, transportation, petroleum, and chemical etc. If an attack on the CPS is successful, the consequences will be unthinkable in pharmaceutical care. A well-designed CPS risk assessment will offer an overall picture of CPS security status and will aid in the optimal deployment of safeguard resources in pharmaceutical care. Despite the numerous similarities between CPS and IT systems, they differ in many ways, most notably the demand for real-time. As a result, CPS cannot successfully utilize standard risk assessment techniques for IT systems. Creative ideas on CPS risk assessment are desperately needed. In this study a survey has been conducted for cyber risk estimation which can help in pharmaceutical care.

articleTitle: Utilization of Parallel Transmission in the Network Using MAC Protocol With Back Off Algorithm in WSN
abstract: Parallel transmission is a general concept in networking that involves the simultaneous sending of multiple data streams to increase the amount of data that can be transferred in a given time period. In this technique, the data is divided into several small parts and each part is sent along multiple paths in parallel to reduce latency and improve the total data throughput of the network. The Media Access Control (MAC) protocol is used to mediate communication between nodes in an Ethernet network. It allocates bandwidth between the nodes and guarantees that multiple nodes can communicate simultaneously without any collision. The MAC protocol also plays a critical role in the utilization of parallel transmission in a network as it is used to achieve efficient and reliable delivery of bits along multiple paths. By using parallel transmission, MAC protocol ensures reliable, low latency, and high throughput communication. Furthermore, it helps to reduce the chances of data loss by increasing the number of available paths for transmission. In order to improve network performance, modern networks are now using parallel transmission in combination with other technologies such as Quality of Service (QoS) and Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR). These technologies are designed to provide more efficient use of communication channels and increase the data rate of networks in general. Additionally, parallel transmission is being used in various wireless communication networks to improve the efficiency of data transmission. All in all, parallel transmission is becoming increasingly popular in networking due to its ability to significantly improve transmission speed and reduce latency. The MAC protocol is an important part of this technology as it facilitates reliable transmission of packets along multiple paths through careful allocation of bandwidth. As a result, the utilization of parallel transmission and MAC protocol in networking has become a popular way to significantly improve the data rate and quality of service of a network.

articleTitle: Predict Success of a Zomato Restaurant using Machine Learning
abstract: Making an informed decision when choosing a restaurant has grown more challenging as the number of restaurants in Bangalore has increased. To assist in decision-making, websites like Zomato offer restaurant ratings and reviews. However, the quality of reviews can be subjective and biased. Therefore, predicting restaurant ratings can provide a more accurate representation of a restaurant’s quality and aid consumers in their decision-making process. This research paper aims to predict restaurant ratings in Bangalore using Zomato data. We will utilize machine learning methods like Linear Regression, Random Forest, and KNN to predict the rating of a restaurant. The study will also identify the features that contribute to higher ratings, such as location, price range, and type of cuisine. This research can assist both consumers in choosing the best restaurants and restaurant owners in identifying areas for improvement and increasing their ratings.

articleTitle: The Enhanced Performance of Hierarchical Fusion Based Data Mining for High Density Data Traffic in Big Data Servers
abstract: Hierarchical fusion based data mining is a novel approach to analyzing high density data traffic, where multiple sources of data are combined in a hierarchical manner to develop an effective representation for the data. This is typically done by creating a hierarchical structure in the form of a tree, consisting of multiple methods for feature extraction, clustering and data classification. These hierarchical structures can be used to identify patterns in the data that are not easily discernible otherwise. The hierarchical fusion based data mining has been applied to a variety of domains such as image analysis, text mining, and web mining. It has been shown to be effective in finding patterns in high density data traffic, which otherwise may be difficult to detect due to the sheer volume of data. Additionally, the hierarchical structure allows for better scalability when the data sets grow with more data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Optimization of Inverter Drive Parameters for Enhanced Electric Vehicle Efficiency: An In-Depth Analysis and Application
abstract: Inverter drives play a crucial role in various industrial applications, where optimizing their parameters is essential for enhancing efficiency and performance. This work presents an advanced technique to optimize the DC Link Voltage (u_dc_k) parameter in inverter drives using machine learning techniques. Traditional methods of parameter optimization have faced challenges in terms of complexity and adaptability. This work proposes a data-driven approach that leverages machine learning models, including linear regression, decision tree, and random forest, to predict the optimized u_dc_k values. The dataset, comprising multiple features related to inverter drives, undergoes pre-processing to handle missing data and scale features. The performance of the machine learning models is evaluated using the root mean squared error (RMSE) metric, and k-fold cross-validation is employed for model comparison. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of machine learning techniques in predicting optimized u_dc_k values, with the best-performing model yielding improved performance compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Based Resource Allocation with Relay Method for MIMO WSN
abstract: Energy efficiency based resource allocation with relay method for MIMO WSNs has been gaining popularity lately as an effective communication network approach. Compared to traditional networking schemes, this method offers higher data rate and improved spectral efficiency. Furthermore, it contributes to the implementation of distributed MIMO solutions, allowing for simpler interconnections between nodes and better signal coverage in a dense network. In this paper, we present an energy efficiency based resource allocation algorithm for MIMO WSNs enabling the use of relays to enhance capacity and increase coverage. The proposed algorithm uses an optimization method based on convex-hull driven scheduling as well as an efficient resource partitioning technique. Additionally, the paper also provides a detailed analysis of the system’s performance concerning energy efficiency. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can lead to significant improvement in network throughput, energy efficiency and coverage. Moreover, it can also yield a better resource allocation performance than the state-of-the-art algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multilevel Center Embedding approach for Sentence Similarity having Complex structures
abstract: The volume of text data, including internet reviews, media posts, and academic articles, has significantly increased in recent years. Text similarity measurements are essential for many applications, including various language processing tasks and IR based systems. However, when dealing with complicated structures like lengthy sentences, having main and subordinate clauses in terms of compound/complex sentences as well, these similarity measurements become more difficult. In this article, we provide a multilevel center embedding method for determining similarity in such text. The suggested method makes use of several embedding levels, such as word, pos, clause, and sentence levels, to capture the intricate structure of text. By constructing the center embedding of a sentence and then iteratively computes the difference between an original center embedding and modified versions of the sentence by applying the center embedding in a leveled manner that introduces a new level of abstraction. Our findings show that, the multilevel center embedding strategy outperforms in category of complicated structured based phrases/sentences.

Author Keywords: Center Word and Multilevel Center Embedding

articleTitle: Image Inpainting for Fingerprint Reconstruction
abstract: Numerous digital authentication systems have been developed by the researchers over the decades. Finger print-based identification is still widely used due to its many advantages. This is one of the most extensively used methods for employee identification in many organizations. It is most popular system adopted by corporate and private organizations for their employee monitoring. Digital gadget subscribers are also increasing tremendously over the decades. Most digital gadgets available in market uses fingerprint based user authentication. Under all these circumstances effective user identification is crucial which even include identification with damaged fingerprint impressions. It has been observed that owing to slight finger cuts or various scratches during winter season or burns of the finger screen affect the fingerprint impression. They appear damaged to interfere with the accuracy of user identification. The work presented in this paper investigates the possibilities of reconstructing the user fingerprint image using image in painting techniques. The fingerprint impression which is poor due to the skin conditions has to be reconstructed before used for authentication. The enhanced KNN-SVD method proposed here restores the damaged part of a unique fingerprint impression. The reconstructed fingerprint using.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Computer Basic Education Network Platform Based on GABP Algorithm
abstract: With the widespread application of computer and network technology in education, education has entered the fast lane of information technology development. Education network platforms provide various information services for education and teaching, playing an increasingly important role in current education informatization. The design and application of a computer basic education network platform based on the Gabp algorithm is an innovative method to improve students’ computer literacy. The Gabp algorithm represents gradient adaptive backpropagation and is a machine learning technique that has been used in various fields such as image recognition and speech processing. The platform aims to provide students with an interactive and engaging learning experience by integrating multimedia elements such as videos, animations, and interactive quizzes. The Gabp algorithm is used to personalize each student’s learning experience based on their personal progress and performance. The application of this platform may benefit schools, colleges, and universities where computer literacy is crucial. It can also be used in online learning environments to provide accessible education for individuals who may not be able to use traditional classroom environments. Overall, the design and application of a computer basic education network platform based on the Gabp algorithm may completely change the way we teach computer skills and improve students’ digital literacy.

articleTitle: Implementation of Discrete HMMs for Isolated Spoken Word Recognition
abstract: Isolated spoken words are acoustically separated from other spoken words by moments of silence. In this work, we have implemented Discrete Hidden Markov Models (DHMMs) for Isolated Spoken Words Recognition. Discrete HMMs have been successfully used in many temporal pattern recognition problems like speech recognition, handwriting recognition, gesture recognition, etc., for more than four decades. We have implemented a basic HMM from scratch in Java language and applied it to train and recognize isolated spoken words. We have tested our implementation in recognizing ten digits on a custom built speaker database. We have obtained an accuracy of 95 % and 82.5% for training and testing respectively.

articleTitle: Improvement of Apriori Algorithm and its Application in College Students PE Online Teaching System Platform
abstract: College students sports online teaching platform has good teaching effectiveness, so it has been popularized in the field of college physical education. However, due to time constraints, the effectiveness of this platform has not been fully played. Therefore, in order to solve this problem, this paper will focus on improving the Apriori algorithm to carry out research. The basic concept of Apriori algorithm is introduced, and then it is improved, and finally the system platform is reformed to promote the algorithm into the platform, and the reasonable application mode of algorithm in the system platform is introduced. Through the research, it is proved that the online teaching system platform can play a full role under the improved Apriori algorithm, and can effectively improve the quality of physical education.

articleTitle: Development of 3D Modeling Parameter Design in Furniture Design
abstract: Today, with the rapid development of science and technology and information technology, virtual reality technology has become increasingly mature and popular, and is increasingly applied to the field of information multimedia display. Based on Web3D technology virtual reality display design, taking furniture display as an example, this paper analyzes the current 3D modeling virtual display, panoramic virtual display and other technologies using literature analysis and case analysis, and carries out application-oriented research based on the characteristics of virtual furniture display. The development of 3D modeling parametric design in furniture design has completely changed the way designers and manufacturers manufacture furniture. By using advanced software, designers can now create accurate and detailed 3D models for their designs, enabling them to visualize and improve their ideas before actual production. A key advantage of 3D modeling is that it allows designers to try different materials, colors, textures and finishes. They can also test various configurations, sizes and proportions until the desired results are achieved. This method saves the time and money of the physical prototype and reduces the risk of errors or inconsistencies in the final product. Another advantage is that parametric design allows more accuracy in designing complex geometry, which is difficult to achieve manually. Taking the furniture exhibition hall and the sofa in the model library as examples, this paper verifies the feasibility of the furniture display design based on panoramic technology and three-dimensional modeling technology. This study involves the production, dissemination, sales and other aspects of furniture products, provides a design fulcrum for the development of furniture display under the new economic conditions, and has very important practical significance for the healthy and sustainable development of the furniture industry.

articleTitle: Gateway DCU for Backbone Network Communication Architecture in a Vehicle or in LAN Network
abstract: Communication systems in vehicles play a critical role in enabling efficient data transfer and network connectivity. In automotive communication, this paper explores the protocols, network architectures, and the emergence of a backbone network architecture. Furthermore, with the growing automation in various systems, such as smart grids and automobiles, controllers have become pivotal components. These necessitate the consideration of factors such as data transfer speed, security, cost-effectiveness, and overall effectiveness in the design of automated systems. The focus is on proposing a backbone topology that can be applied in LAN networks and automotive settings. While Controller Area Network (CAN) is a prominent communication protocol in vehicles, the paper also examines the promising future of automotive Ethernet. By integrating Ethernet connectivity into existing networks, improvements in security, speed, and cost-effectiveness can be achieved. These advancements extend beyond vehicle networks and have potential applications in other automated systems, including home automation. Index Terms—Intra- Vehicular Communication, CAN, Ethernet, Backbone Network, Communication architecture, Controller

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Identification of Fake Profiles in Social Media
abstract: Fake profiles have been developed as social media usage has increased, which can result in identity theft, cyberbullying, and online fraud. In order to secure internet users, efficient phony profile detection systems are required. In this study, we assess the efficacy of three well-known machine-learning algorithms and deep learning methods for the detection of fake profiles such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, and Neural Networks.The dataset aided for training and testing includes several variables taken from social media profiles, such as status_ count, followers count, friends count, favorites count, and listed count. The testing results demonstrate that all three algorithms are capable of identifying phony profiles with a high degree of accuracy, with neural networks having the best accuracy (99.2%). This study implies that machine learning algorithms have the potential to identify fraudulent profiles.

articleTitle: Analysis of MIMO NOMA using Iterative ML and LMMSE Detection
abstract: The non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) plays major role in radio access to improve the performance of individual for cellular communication technology as compared to state of art technology which is well-known as Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA). This research work focus on the power domain NOMA, by employing superposition coding (SC) at sender and for cancellation of successive interference at receiver, together to estimate the channel performance. The present work examines and also suggest hybrid techniques which are combinations of NOMA and OFDM for better power allocation, bandwidth efficiency, fairness of users and modern analysis using NOMA which is part of 5G communications. One of the specific results of NOMA, MIMO and OFDM combination system are specifically focused in this paper. The LMMSE a linear detector is proposed to help in detecting multiple users and also provides low latency, in turn effects on the performance of BER and PAPR. A synchronized LMMSE is being demonstrated when the MIMO-NOMA combinational method is used to achieve better channel estimation and capacity allocation. To obtain the iterative identification rate that is required, the proposed research work is presenting matching constraints with the help of decoders and with the help of identifiers of MIMO-NOMA. The complete possibility of highest significant levels that are in the area of a symmetric MIMO-NOMA are presented for iterative LMMSE detection that achieves more performance, better than the modern approaches and it is evidently found that it has 1.4dB better than the previous throughput. Using Symmetric MIMO-NOMA, various efficiency of modulation strategies BPSK and QAM are used to encode the sender data. The proposed method has achieved significant amount of enhancement in various parameters, including BER LMMSE, PAPR and the capacity of the channel and it is tested and validated under $2 \times 2$ and $4 \times 4$ arrays of antenna sizes.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Agent to Automate HR Process
abstract: This study seeks to increase the effectiveness of human resource procedures with the automation of repetitive time consuming tasks. To assist HR workers and streamline contact with employees, a software robot that uses UiPath to automate HR duties has been created. The recruitment process, onboarding, and work distribution are just a few of the HR duties that the robot is intended to automate. To determine its impact, the robot is being hosted by a respected company. According to the study’s findings, these jobs now take 80% less time and effort to do on average, and they also cost 60% less money.

articleTitle: Secure Blockchain-based Framework for Smart City Applications
abstract: A city is considered to be smart if it makes use of information and communication technology (ICT) to boost its operational efficacy, enhance the level of government services and citizen welfare, and disseminate information to the general public. The fundamental goal of a smart city is to optimise the efficiency of city operations, stimulate economic progress, and improve the quality of life for its citizens. This is accomplished by exploiting cutting-edge technical advancements and conducting in-depth data analysis. The smart city’s communication happens through various devices, i.e., smart Internet of Things (IoT) devices, servers and smartphone. The data is exchanged through an insecure medium (i.e., the Internet). Therefore, the potential adversary gets a chance to launch some cyber attacks over this. Hence we need to deploy some security mechanisms in the smart city’s applications to provide some security to it. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a blockchain-based framework for the secure data exchange of the smart city’s applications and services. Furthermore, the practical implementation of the proposed framework is also provided to check its usability in the real-time environment.

articleTitle: Distributing the Role of Cluster Head Among the Nodes for Prolonging the Network Lifetime Using AODV Protocol in WSN
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are highly efficient networks that are used for remote monitoring and data gathering for a wide array of applications. These networks are often deployed in remote and difficult to reach places where recharging or replacement of the sensors is not feasible. As such, maximizing the network lifetime has become a major concern for system designers. One of the key parameters of WSNs is their routing protocol. In this paper, we have considered AODV, an adaptive and reactive routing protocol, and studied its effects on the lifetime of a WSN. Our study found that the increased presence of local or intra-cluster traffic significantly improved the performance and network lifetime of the network. Moreover, the use of AODV was able to extend the lifetime of the WSN by up to 30% on average when compared with a more traditional DSR protocol. Additionally, we observed that even in cases where the traffic is not congestion-limited the use of AODV leads to increased packet reception rates and higher throughput, thus leading to further prolongation of the WSNs lifetime.

articleTitle: An Innovative Examination of Tensor Blending Network for Multi-Model Sentimental optimization Using Opinion Mining
abstract: The Tensor Blending Network (TBN) for multi-model sentimental optimization is a novel approach for fusing the outputs of multiple models in order to maximize the performance of sentiment analysis. TBN is based on an encoder-decoder architecture consisting of a convolutional neural network (CNN), a Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) RNN, and a deep-learning model for sentiment classification. TBN uses attention mechanisms to blend the output of each model, focusing on the most relevant parts to extract the desirable sentiment analysis. The framework of TBN is also designed in a way that allows for easy deployment in different contexts, as the user can fuse two predefined models or multiple individual ones. Additionally, the TBN architecture can be used as a method to improve the accuracy and precision of sentiment analysis algorithms by integrating different sources of knowledge. Finally, the performance of TBN has been tested on a number of datasets, obtaining in most cases the highest accuracy and precision, proving the advantages of using this framework.

articleTitle: Agricultural Management System Based on GPS and GIS
abstract: This article introduces an intelligent agricultural management system based on Global Positioning System (GPS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). This system uses GPS technology for geographic positioning and precise positioning of farmland, collects high-precision geographic information data, and combines GIS technology for analysis, processing, and visualization presentation. This system can intelligently manage farmland, including crop planting, fertilization, irrigation, harvesting, and other processes. At the same time, it can monitor and predict environmental factors such as soil moisture, temperature, and light, and make timely adjustments to ensure the healthy growth, high yield, and stability of crops. The advantages of this system include improving production efficiency, reducing losses, saving resource costs, and increasing profits. The experimental results indicate that the system can effectively improve agricultural production efficiency, promote sustainable development of agriculture, and is of great significance for achieving precision agriculture, agricultural intelligence, and other directions..

articleTitle: The Enhanced Multimodal Decomposition Matrix Analysis of Bio Medical Imaging for Eye Cancer Prediction
abstract: This paper presents the use of a multimodal decomposition matrix analysis (MDMA) for the prediction of eye cancer in bio medical imaging. The proposed method uses upper level graph-based algorithms to capture both the structural and semantic information inherent in the images. The first step of the method is to decompose the medical images into a set of lower-level matrices. Then, we apply a principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the dimensionality of the data. Finally, the resulting lower-dimensional matrix is used to build a classifier which is used to predict the presence of eye cancer. The proposed approach is evaluated on a publicly available dataset and results show that the proposed method outperforms the existing state-of-the-art cancer prediction models. These results demonstrate the potential of MDMA to accurately predict eye cancer in bio medical imaging.

articleTitle: Determination of Maximum Allowable Data Transfer Rate by Bluetooth LET Energy Method in WSN
abstract: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is an advanced technology designed by the Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG) to enable and provide very low power wireless communication between devices. BLE is the dominant protocol used in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Using BLE technology in a WSN allows users to collect data, control and manage networks of devices, provide real-time monitoring and control, and improve the accuracy of sensor networks. The maximum allowable data transfer rate for BLE in WSNs is 8.4 Mbps. This transfer rate is achieved when all of the network nodes are simultaneously transmitting data. Additionally, this rate can be adapted depending on the specific application requirements. For instance, the rate can be adapted to support slower network throughputs, such as to allow for higher latency and lower complexity applications, or to enable faster data transfer rates for real-time applications that require more data. In addition to the maximum data rate, the increased networking capabilities offered by BLE also enable longer range communication. With BLE, WSNs can cover a much greater distance than traditional wireless technologies, ranging up to 400 meters in a line-of-sight environment. Moreover, even when the signal strength is weak and the line-of-sight environment is not favorable, BLE can still be used to typically cover 30 meters, which is much more than the 10-meter range of traditional wireless communication. Overall, BLE technology is an attractive option for users looking to build a robust, low power, and reliable WSN that offers high data rates and long-distance communication.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Real-Time Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems for Next Generation Networks
abstract: Network security is facing new difficulties as a result of the development of 5G and other networks as well as software-defined networking (SDN). As the volume and complexity of network traffic increase, so does the risk of cyber threats and attacks. Designing and implementing a real-time Intrusion Detection and Prevention System (IDPS) for 5G and beyond SDNs requires addressing several challenges. These challenges include the high data rate and volume of traffic, the distributed and dynamic nature of 5G and beyond networks, and the complexity of the SDN architecture. A global IDPS architecture should be created to address these issues, using methods based on machine learning to quickly identify and categorize intrusions. To allow actual time monitoring and avoidance, the IDPS should also work across all the SDN design layers and interact with the SDN router. The implementation of a real-time IDPS for 5G and beyond SDNs would enhance network security by enabling real-time detection and prevention of intrusions. This would reduce the risk of data breaches, network downtime, and other Cyber Security threats.
